question: For each single-component ablation of BearMamba3Frozen (bm3_frozen) -- conv-embed stem (frozen_noconv), z-gating (frozen_nogate), A's parameterization (frozen_As4d), per arch_map.md SS5a/SS5b/SS5c -- does removing that one component causally hurt bm3_frozen's macro-F1 performance under the AWGN noise column, and does the ablated arm still retain an edge over the never-selective s4d floor baseline?

arm_semantics.bm3_frozen: full frozen-selectivity baseline (BearMamba3Frozen, bm3_frozen.py): all three ablatable components present -- kernel=7 conv_embed stem, z-gating, A_const (heavy_tail_activation+clamp parameterization). Same arm used as frozensel's frozen baseline.
arm_semantics.frozen_noconv: bm3_frozen with conv_embed replaced by StridedLinearStem (no nn.Conv1d anywhere in the forward path; explicit stride-slice + per-timestep Linear, provably same map/output-length as the removed kernel=1 conv revision) -- ablates cross-timestep mixing only (arch_map.md SS5a).
arm_semantics.frozen_nogate: bm3_frozen with z-gating removed (in_proj rebuilt to drop the z slice; fused kernel called with Z=None, so the gating multiply does not execute at all, verified against mamba3_siso_fwd.py's HAS_Z compile-time flag) -- ablates input-dependent gating only (arch_map.md SS5b).
arm_semantics.frozen_As4d: bm3_frozen with A's parameterization changed from A_const (heavy_tail_activation+clamp) to A_log with A = -exp(A_log), an S4D-style reparameterization -- ablates the frozen-selectivity A parameterization only (arch_map.md SS5c). A single-line functional-form ablation, not a full S4D kernel swap.
arm_semantics.s4d: never-selective S4D baseline, same arm used as frozensel's and fullgrid's floor baseline. Cells in this grid were reused/copied from results/frozensel_20260702-1827/cells.jsonl per launch_secondary.sh's documented optional pre-launch step (identical best_macro_f1 and train_order_sha256 per (condition,seed), verified by direct comparison of the two cells.jsonl files) -- the same eval_sha256 fairness invariant holds because both grids construct base_test identically via xjtu_noisy_harness.py's unmodified make_cross_condition_split()/XJTUDataset().

fairness_verification_required.rule: Before any aggregation, recompute eval_sha256 independently for the grid's test split (same base_test / XJTUDatasetNoisy('clean', None, 0) construction the harness itself uses at run_grid() start, via xjtu_noisy_harness.make_cross_condition_split()/XJTUDataset()/eval_fingerprint()) and assert every one of the 175 cells' fairness.eval_sha256 equals this recomputed full hash byte-for-byte (all 64 hex chars, not just a prefix). If any cell's eval_sha256 differs from the recomputed value, aggregation MUST be rejected and a fairness_report.json with all_pass=false written instead of q_secondary.*/secondary_curve.png/secondary_decision.json.
fairness_verification_required.min_cells_gate: If completed cells != 175 (the full design), or the observed (condition,arm,seed) tuple set duplicates or omits any of the expected 5x7x5=175 tuples, do not aggregate; write a needs_human.json instead, mirroring results/secondary_needs_human_20260703-0841/. (Guardrail 0 of the task assigning this analysis already verified 175/175, no dup/no missing, against results/secondary_20260703-1034/cells.jsonl specifically -- ignoring other secondary_* directories, none of which contain a cells.jsonl.)

chance_floor.rationale: N_CLASSES=2 (binary cross-condition fault classification, per xjtu_noisy_harness.py N_CLASSES=2); chance=50%. Matches the exact threshold already used in results/fullgrid_20260627-1731/decision.json and results/frozensel_prereg_20260702-1826/frozensel_prereg.json, for consistency across this project's grids.
chance_floor.application: A (condition, arm) cell-mean is 'at_chance' if mean_macro_f1 <= 0.55. For a given component arm X, a condition is 'meaningful' for the bm3_frozen-vs-X comparison only if BOTH bm3_frozen's and X's condition-means are > 0.55 in that condition; otherwise it is excluded from that component's win/loss tally below (recorded, not discarded). Symmetrically, a condition is 'meaningful' for the X-vs-s4d context comparison only if both X's and s4d's condition-means are > 0.55.

per_condition_aggregation.unit: for each (condition, arm) across all 5 arms: mean_macro_f1 and std_macro_f1 across all completed seeds, n_seeds_used reported alongside.
per_condition_aggregation.decisive_band_rule: non-overlapping mean+/-std bands (the SAME heuristic frozensel_prereg_20260702-1826.json used as its original significance_rule -- a magnitude/dispersion comparison at the aggregate level, not a p-value test): for a given component arm X, bm3_frozen SIGNIFICANTLY beats X in a condition iff (mean_frozen - std_frozen) > (mean_X + std_X). Symmetric definition for X beating bm3_frozen. If bands overlap, the condition is a TIE (no significant difference) regardless of which mean is nominally higher. THIS band rule, not the paired significance test below, is what secondary_decision.json's per-arm/overall verdicts are mechanically computed from.
per_condition_aggregation.paired_significance_reporting_only: In addition, secondary_aggregate.py computes a real paired-sample significance test (paired t-test via scipy.stats.ttest_rel, plus Wilcoxon signed-rank as a non-parametric cross-check), matched by seed (same seed = same split/init/noise-instance across arms), for Delta(frozen-X) and Delta(X-s4d) in every condition, for every component arm X. This paired test is REPORTING ONLY -- it supplements but does NOT replace or feed into the decisive_band_rule above, and MUST NOT be cited as the basis for any verdict in secondary_decision.json. This mirrors frozensel_paired_significance.py's own documented relationship to frozensel_decision.json ('supplements, does not replace').
per_condition_aggregation.linkage: every per_condition entry in secondary_decision.json must carry n_cells_frozen/n_cells_X/n_cells_s4d and the exact list of seeds contributing, so each aggregate number traces back to specific cells.jsonl rows. Every condition (including at-chance / non-meaningful ones) must be present in the emitted per_condition evidence table -- summarizing to a majority count must never omit or hide a condition's raw evidence row.

per_component_verdicts.COMPONENT_CONTRIBUTES: bm3_frozen significantly beats X (per decisive_band_rule) in a STRICT MAJORITY of meaningful conditions, AND bm3_frozen does not lose significantly to X in any meaningful condition. Interpreted as: removing this component causally hurts bm3_frozen's performance.
per_component_verdicts.COMPONENT_NOT_SHOWN_TO_CONTRIBUTE: bm3_frozen does NOT significantly beat X in a strict majority of meaningful conditions -- i.e. ties and/or X-wins dominate or are tied with frozen-wins. This is the default/null outcome.
per_component_verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 2 meaningful conditions exist for this component's bm3_frozen-vs-X comparison (everything at-chance for one or both arms), OR completed cells for {bm3_frozen, X} across the 7 conditions x 5 seeds < min_acceptable_seeds x 7 x 2 = 70.

decision_rule.tie_break: 'strict majority' = more than half of meaningful conditions; if the count of meaningful conditions is even and exactly half are frozen-wins, that is NOT a strict majority -> falls through to COMPONENT_NOT_SHOWN_TO_CONTRIBUTE (ties favor the null/default outcome, not the claim). Identical to frozensel_prereg_20260702-1826.json's tie_break.

overall_verdict.unit: count of component arms (out of 3: frozen_noconv, frozen_nogate, frozen_As4d) whose per_component_verdict is COMPONENT_CONTRIBUTES.
overall_verdict.PARTIAL_COMPONENTS_CONTRIBUTE: 1 or 2 component arms are COMPONENT_CONTRIBUTES (the overall verdict names exactly which).
overall_verdict.NO_COMPONENTS_SHOWN_TO_CONTRIBUTE: 0 component arms are COMPONENT_CONTRIBUTES (all 3 are COMPONENT_NOT_SHOWN_TO_CONTRIBUTE or INCONCLUSIVE).
overall_verdict.OVERALL_INCONCLUSIVE: any component arm's per_component_verdict is INCONCLUSIVE (data-insufficiency at the per-component level propagates to the overall verdict rather than being silently dropped from the count).

decision_rule.context_only_not_decisive: For each component arm X, Delta(X - s4d) per condition is reported for context (does the ablated arm still retain an edge over the never-selective floor baseline) but does NOT enter any per_component_verdict or the overall_verdict, which are scoped strictly to the bm3_frozen-vs-X causal-contribution question. Mirrors frozensel_prereg_20260702-1826.json's context_only_not_decisive treatment of bm3_kin-vs-s4d/bm3_frozen-vs-s4d.
